causes of tingling and numbness in elderly in patients.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E1.Diabetes :\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp;patient is a known case of diabetes and on medication.(diabetic neuropathy)\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/www.mayoclinic.org\/diseases-conditions\/diabetic-neuropathy\/symptoms-causes\/syc-20371580\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/www.mayoclinic.org\/diseases-conditions\/diabetic-neuropathy\/symptoms-causes\/syc-20371580\u003C\/a\u003E\u003Cspan face=\"mayo-sans, sans-serif\" style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: auto; color: #080808;\"\u003EDiabetic neuropathy is a type of nerve damage that can occur if you have diabetes. High blood sugar (glucose) can injure nerves throughout the body. Diabetic neuropathy most often damages nerves in the legs and feet.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan face=\"mayo-sans, sans-serif\" style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: auto; color: #080808; font-size: small;\"\u003EDepending on the affected nerves, diabetic neuropathy symptoms include pain and numbness in the legs, feet and hands. It can also cause problems with the digestive system, urinary tract, blood vessels and heart. Some people have mild symptoms. But for others, diabetic neuropathy can be quite painful and disabling.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan face=\"mayo-sans, sans-serif\" style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: auto; color: #080808; font-size: small;\"\u003EDiabetic neuropathy is a serious diabetes complication that may affect as many as 50% of people with diabetes. But you can often prevent diabetic neuropathy or slow its progress with consistent blood sugar management and a healthy lifestyle.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; In view of her bilateral knee pain orthopaedic opinion was taken and diagnosed as osteoarthritis and they suggested physiotherapy.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: large;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003ECase 2:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/srilekha77.blogspot.com\/2023\/02\/40-year-old-male-with-acute-viral.html\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/srilekha77.blogspot.com\/2023\/02\/40-year-old-male-with-acute-viral.html\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003EMy approach to this case:\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E1) IS IT PRE HEPATIC OR HEPATIC OR POST HEPATIC JAUNDICE???\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em; text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cimg border=\"0\" data-original-height=\"855\" data-original-width=\"1562\" height=\"121\" src=\"https:\/\/blogger.googleusercontent.com\/img\/b\/R29vZ2xl\/AVvXsEiK8o77zUqG7lKZI4wWeapsjAUG2EJMq9hRpsEAmih_nesh8_mL9p-mcixhwvxQcRD8KUq-vvHiFSyDZKxJXxHhJw7HfMyHHZEol7Y-Lx_S-9p8XQUnKos7TF75AYQGEY4a2KVBhpR8HFgInH-QAXcRjU76G7IitHkOg3loRBTxq1cP-7yXhDRDiJ1s\/w221-h121\/4968ED48-22EC-45A3-B403-1A7231A850A9.jpeg\" width=\"221\" \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003EPatient presented with yellowish discolouration of eyes and urine,itching and weight loss.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003EOn presentation the total bilirubin was 9.27 mg\/dl of which 9.12 mg\/dl is direct bilirubin and\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003EALP of 547 IU\/l. So based on presentation and lab findings it is mostly post hepatic\/hepatic jaundice.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E2)what is the exact cause ???\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003EPatient is an alcoholic since years,excess alcohol causing cirrhosis and then jaundice or could there be any structural abnormality or gall stones\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003EUSG abdomen was normal ruling out gall stones and MRCP was done to rule out anatomical abnormalities which was also normal.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003EViral markers were normal ruling out viral hepatitis so most probably alcohol would have caused jaundice in this patient.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cimg border=\"0\" data-original-height=\"1028\" data-original-width=\"1668\" height=\"232\" src=\"https:\/\/blogger.googleusercontent.com\/img\/b\/R29vZ2xl\/AVvXsEjxCeP0Vn3df133Bip7Whe3TGB3Vy5aysxb3pIXnwEeKjhpA8f6THn1i2G689qyfIo1OXCMgG95H93BD7ZZLWLkWZkV9FkI8Luo5R0Fg1lFtCXgsHy6_lyGU-ltpMnaM-gINwzikXu2WejtJ7y3nPAc8yYGq1lBMftFwghb_jJocaa4IQVwDRHRYJ_C\/w378-h232\/5060E8AA-3718-4A44-A5BC-DCF96830E72C.jpeg\" width=\"378\" \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cb\u003ECase 3:\u003C\/b\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cspan\u003Ehttps:\/\/srilekha77.blogspot.com\/2023\/02\/62-year-old-male-with-shortness-of.html\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003EApproach to shortness of breath in this case:\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003Ewhy is it important to evaluate cause of sob in this particular patient: patient had history of PCTA \u0026nbsp;the long term known risk of angioplasty is re stenosis.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov\/books\/NBK535417\/\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan face=\"arial, helvetica, clean, sans-serif\" style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; color: #985735;\"\u003EComplications\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; font-family: \u0026quot;Times New Roman\u0026quot;, serif;\"\u003EPTCA is widely practiced and has risks, but major procedural complications are rare. The mortality rate during angioplasty is 1.2%.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Ca aria-expanded=\"false\" aria-haspopup=\"true\" class=\"bk_pop\" data-bk-pop-href=\"#article-26936.r4\" href=\"https:\/\/www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov\/books\/NBK535417\/#\" role=\"button\" style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; color: #642a8f; font-family: \u0026quot;Times New Roman\u0026quot;, serif;\"\u003E[4]\u003C\/a\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; font-family: \u0026quot;Times New Roman\u0026quot;, serif;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; font-family: \u0026quot;Times New Roman\u0026quot;, serif;\"\u003EPeople older than the age of 65, with kidney disease or diabetes, women, and those with massive heart disease are at a higher risk for complications. Possible complications include hematoma at the femoral artery insertion site, pseudoaneurysm of the femoral artery, infection of skin over femoral artery, embolism, stroke, kidney injury from contrast dye, hypersensitivity to dye, vessel rupture, coronary artery dissection, bleeding, vasospasm, thrombus formation, and acute MI. There is a long-term\u0026nbsp;risk of re-stenosis of the stented vessel.\u003C\/span\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E*6 min walk test is done, learned first time about 6 min walk test and it’s importance\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/www.physio-pedia.com\/Six_Minute_Walk_Test_\/_6_Minute_Walk_Test\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/www.physio-pedia.com\/Six_Minute_Walk_Test_\/_6_Minute_Walk_Test\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cb\u003ECase 4:\u003C\/b\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/srilekha77.blogspot.com\/2023\/03\/45-year-old-male-with-dengue.html\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cspan\u003Egoog_1878733845\u003C\/span\u003Ehttps:\/\/srilekha77.blogspot.com\/2023\/03\/45-year-old-male-with-dengue.html\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003Elearning points from this case:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp; Would the prognosis had been better if he was brought early to hospital ???\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003EYes, I read this following article\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/www.physio-pedia.com\/Stroke\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/www.physio-pedia.com\/Stroke\u003C\/a\u003E\u0026nbsp;Which stated:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan face=\"tisapro-regular, Georgia, serif\" style=\"-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; background-color: white; caret-color: rgb(2, 6, 33); color: #020621; letter-spacing: 0.3199999928474426px;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: x-small;\"\u003ERegardless the type of stroke, it is important to know that with each minute of large vessel ischemic stroke untreated, close to two million neurons die. This is the most important \"time is brain\" concept in understanding acute stroke and its treatment.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E2.Impending heart failure??? He also had shortness of breath,his CXR showed right sided pleural effusion and the same finding on usg thorax as well,2D echo showed EF of 29% only.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003ECause of heart failure in this case??? Difference between ejection fraction reduced and ejection fraction preserved heart failure.......\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; font-size: medium;\"\u003EPSYCHIATRY POSTINGS (14\/3\/23-28\/3\/23)\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003EI’ve learnt the Importance of psychiatry postings in internship throug few cases I saw.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003EI’ve always wanted to become a psychiatrist ,these 15 days of psychiatry posting gave me an idea about the department overall.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cspan\u003EThere are some medical conditions which presents as \/ have psychiatry component in them,\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan\u003Eso we as doctors should be able to differentiate them and help patients in giving them what exactly they want.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E1.I’ve learned how Parkinson’s disease \u0026nbsp;and psychiatry symptoms can occur together , so when we treat a case of Parkinson’s we should also look into the mental aspects of the patient to help them more.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov\/pmc\/articles\/PMC6236081\/\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov\/pmc\/articles\/PMC6236081\/\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/blogger.googleusercontent.com\/img\/b\/R29vZ2xl\/AVvXsEi3l0MVMwMDDlfuCP8H0S5XQoUhfYEyWeJZenql4-35Rloeqqz45E4BhBWRyrCF3SFwqfWbWyu2H-wVubbchkhq7HdyYurBtjvNb1gDwb8IhXeZS1TZ5w0JnZxIOcQ3b4fRVTIfX6iMcTYXVD_cnTMP-svywcah18O8jtxwcxSS3a7J0XoBJNYKzwH_\/s1569\/2540BD5A-4959-4524-B3BF-DA2FAED2F7B1.jpeg\" style=\"margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;\"\u003E\u003Cimg border=\"0\" data-original-height=\"1499\" data-original-width=\"1569\" height=\"306\" src=\"https:\/\/blogger.googleusercontent.com\/img\/b\/R29vZ2xl\/AVvXsEi3l0MVMwMDDlfuCP8H0S5XQoUhfYEyWeJZenql4-35Rloeqqz45E4BhBWRyrCF3SFwqfWbWyu2H-wVubbchkhq7HdyYurBtjvNb1gDwb8IhXeZS1TZ5w0JnZxIOcQ3b4fRVTIfX6iMcTYXVD_cnTMP-svywcah18O8jtxwcxSS3a7J0XoBJNYKzwH_\/s320\/2540BD5A-4959-4524-B3BF-DA2FAED2F7B1.jpeg\" width=\"320\" \/\u003E\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: large;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E2.seen very interesting cases of schizophrenia, adjustment disorder, panic attacks,depression and got an overview about how the subject is.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E3. Seen a case where patient present with altered behaviour and having visual hallucinations, when asked about detail history, his family said that he had an episode of stroke (TIA)few months back and started behaving oddly after that. I’ve read this following article after seeing this case .this case fascinated me if the history of stroke was not given it would have been a pure psychiatry case but the history of stroke changed the diagnosis to Organic psychosis!!!!!!!!\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/www.verywellhealth.com\/hallucinations-2488618\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/www.verywellhealth.com\/hallucinations-2488618\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; background-color: white; caret-color: rgb(33, 33, 33); color: #212121; font-family: Merriweather, Verdana, Arial, serif; font-size: 16px;\"\u003EVisual hallucinations can result from strokes that occur either in the visual centers of the brain located in the occipital (Latin for \"back of the head\") lobes or in the brainstem.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan class=\"mntl-inline-citation mntl-dynamic-tooltip--trigger\" data-id=\"#citation-4\" style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; background-position: 0px 0px; border: 0px; box-sizing: inherit; color: #0000ee; cursor: pointer; font-family: Merriweather, Verdana, Arial, serif; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1; margin: 0px 0px 0px 0.125rem; padding: 0px 0px 15px; position: static; vertical-align: super; white-space: nowrap;\" tabindex=\"0\"\u003E4\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E4.M\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003Eonitored a patient with visual hallucinations who was admitted in icu when I was posted in psychiatry\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E5.seen many cases of alcohol and tobacco dependence syndrome in DAC(de addiction centre)and how are they managed with pharmacotherapy and psychotherapy together.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: courier; font-size: medium;\"\u003EPERIPHERALS (29\/3\/24-13\/4\/23)\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cblockquote\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: courier; font-size: medium;\"\u003ENEPHROLOGY DUTIES:\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: courier; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cspan\u003E* Performed an ascitic tap in patient patient who is k\/c\/o CKD and had gross ascites, approximately 1.5-2 litres of fluid was removed and the patient’s symptoms of shortness of breath,abdominal pain and fullness decreased\u003C\/span\u003E\u0026nbsp;.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003C\/blockquote\u003E\u003Cblockquote\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: courier; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp;[\u003Cspan\u003Eunder guidance of Dr.Bharath sir ( pgy2)]\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003C\/blockquote\u003E\u003Cblockquote\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: courier; font-size: medium;\"\u003E* Assissted in a therapeutic \u0026nbsp;pleural tap procedure with Dr.Nishitha mam (pg2) under guidance of Dr.Durga Krishna sir(pgy3) in patient who had massive pleural effusion in left side .\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: courier; font-size: medium;\"\u003E* tried taking an ABG sample,but ended up drawing venous blood for the first time\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003C\/blockquote\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: courier; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;* monitored patients under going dialysis and learned how to manage fluctuating blood pressure during dialysis\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: courier; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cblockquote\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: courier; font-size: medium;\"\u003EDuring ICU Duty:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003C\/blockquote\u003E\u003Cblockquote\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: courier; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cspan\u003E*inserted a ryles tube for the first time in \u0026nbsp;a male patient under guidance of Dr.Keerthi(pgy2)\u003C\/span\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003C\/blockquote\u003E\u003Cblockquote\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: courier; font-size: medium;\"\u003E* inserted a foleys catheter in a male patient.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003C\/blockquote\u003E\u003Cblockquote\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: courier; font-size: medium;\"\u003E*placed IV cannula\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: courier; font-size: medium;\"\u003E*took ABG samples 5 times from radial artery first one with the help of ICU sister and the next ones on my own .Tried taking femoral artery sample.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: courier; font-size: medium;\"\u003E* did CNS examination on a stroke patient who is admitted in icu.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003C\/blockquote\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: courier; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;*learned how to read x-rays of cases like pleural effusion,pulmonary edema,cardiomegaly and got a basic idea of ecg interpretation .\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: courier; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: courier; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;WARD DUTIES:\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: courier; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; *collected venous samples for camp cases\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: courier; Attending rounds everyday was very helpful and learned many new points during the discussion\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; I’ve learnt so many things during my 2 months of internship in general medicine department which are my first hand experiences as a doctor .
